title: About
text: I am an AI Engineer and emerging researcher with a background in applied machine learning, computer vision, retrieval systems, and research. I currently work at Griphic on applied AI systems, while continuing to develop my research interests through experiments, paper reproduction, and technical writing.

title: About
text:
Current Focus
My strongest technical thread combines computer vision, retrieval, and representation learning. I am currently exploring visual and geometric retrieval, robust perception, and multimodal or vision-language representations as research directions rather than treating them as established specializations.
Some of my strongest current professional work is confidential, so I describe it publicly only at a level that respects those boundaries. I prefer public claims that can be supported by code, experiments, publications, or other inspectable evidence.

title: Projects
text:
Selected Work


Physics-Informed Underwater Image Enhancement
My M.Tech. thesis investigated a physics-informed diffusion framework for enhancing underwater images under high-turbidity conditions. It grew from earlier work evaluating state-of-the-art underwater image enhancement models under high turbidity, which was published at NCC 2025.
Related NCC 2025 publication · Thesis-focused technical article on Medium
Computer Vision Diffusion Models Physics-Informed ML Research


Image Similarity Search
Built during my FrugalX internship, this project implements an end-to-end visual retrieval workflow using learned image features, Milvus for vector indexing and similarity search, and MySQL for mapping vector IDs back to image records.
View the repository on GitHub
Visual Retrieval Milvus MySQL Python


WQU Applied AI Lab
A consolidated body of six capstone projects covering computer vision and generative-AI problems, including image classification, object detection, face recognition, and GAN-based image generation. I keep this as evidence of breadth and earlier applied learning rather than as a single flagship project.
View the repository on GitHub

title: Home
text:
AI Engineer · Computer Vision · Retrieval · Research



I’m an Associate AI Engineer at Griphic, where I work on applied AI systems including CAD retrieval and related machine-learning workflows.
My strongest work sits at the intersection of applied machine learning, computer vision, retrieval systems, and research. My background also includes research on efficient and collaborative learning at ABB Corporate Research Center and an M.Tech. thesis on physics-informed diffusion for underwater image enhancement.
I’m currently exploring questions around visual and geometric retrieval, robust perception, and multimodal / vision-language representations through paper-driven experiments and research projects.

title: Home
text:
What I Work On


Applied AI Engineering
Building and evaluating machine-learning systems that connect models with real application workflows, with an emphasis on clear system boundaries and defensible results.


Retrieval Systems
Working with learned representations, vector similarity search, and retrieval pipelines for visual and related search problems.


Computer Vision
Exploring visual understanding and image-enhancement problems, including difficult or degraded imaging conditions and representation quality.


Research & Experimentation
Studying papers through implementation, reproduction, controlled experiments, ablations, failure analysis, and careful interpretation of evidence.
